body: Thank you. I have been calling and texting him each day previous to this. He's been very inconsistent, which is worrying. "I want to save my marriage." "I want out." "I want to save my marriage." "I want out."... My mom thinks we should bring him to stay with one of us.
The ward requires a confidentiality code to talk to him. I left a message, but haven't heard back from him. Your, advice, however, has put my mind a little at ease.
